title: Why it moves
sub: The map before the data, a series on enterprise architecture and why it matters for data: who cares about the utility, what pushes on it, what that means here, what must become true and how anyone will know, and the principles every choice is checked against.
howto: Paper notes on a wall are drafts; glass in the layers' colours is the confirmed model. Purple is the motivation layer. Cyan outlines the technical side, gold the business side.
